subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Some birds have unusually long lifespans compared to their body size.
• Often, these birds possess enhanced DNA repair mechanisms.
• The Arctic tern has exceptional longevity for its size.
• The average lifespan of an Arctic tern is approximately 30 years.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the lifespan of the Arctic tern. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Arctic tern lives for an average of approximately 30 years.
choices.B: Birds with enhanced DNA repair mechanisms often have unusually long lifespans.
choices.C: The Arctic tern, like some other birds, has exceptional longevity for its size.
choices.D: Enhanced DNA repair mechanisms contribute to the Arctic tern's longevity.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the lifespan of the Arctic tern, noting that it lives for an average of approximately 30 years.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence makes a generalization about birds, stating that birds with enhanced DNA repair mechanisms often have long lifespans; it doesn't emphasize the lifespan of the Arctic tern.
